<?php
session_start();
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $new_password = $_POST['new_password'];
    $user_id = $_SESSION['user_id'];
    $conn = get_db_connection();

    echo "Password updated successfully";
}
